title: ASMR Sparkle Flogger: HFO (Standard)
description: Imagine for me, if you will, my sparkle flogger. It's made of a tinsel-like material, light, pretty — all the rainbow colours catching against the shifting light. I love my collection of floggers, and this is one of the most special to me. It's short for that optimal twirl­ability, with many Mylar Falls that flicker upward like a silver-tinged kaleidoscope that captivates the eye. * * * Hopefully this will be especially potent on those who are a bit kinesthetic or who perhaps have trouble focusing and find fidgeting relaxing. Instructions If you're using a Mylar flogger, have it resting ready in your hand before you press play. Ideally you should already be naked, and exposed to its touch. You'll also need clear floorspace to kneel, and any appropriate clean-up supplies ready and prepped as well.
author: Mistress Shibby
